findings.name: Neo Tokyo
findings.evidence_quote: Neo Tokyo is a shop focusing on Japanese culture... There are some arcade machines inside their store... Tokens can be bought... Virtual coin (petals) can be bought at a small PASELI Charge station... E-Amusement passes can be bought at the register... Pictures: Museca (x3). Comment by Zezus 3 years ago: rip reflec beat and jubeat. Games list currently: No games at this location.
findings.note: Japanese pop-culture retail shop (neo-tokyo.no sells snacks/merch, not an arcade chain). ZIv photos document MUSECA; e-amusement/PASELI/e-pass language still on page updated 2025-08-11. Reflec Beat and jubeat reported removed. Current live presence of MUSECA is uncertain because the formal Games table is empty.

findings.name: New Retro arcade neon
findings.evidence_quote: New Retro Arcade: Neon is an Emulator Frontend where you can add and play your own game ROMs in Virtual Reality... support for over 30 arcade cabinets... Address: 32 Hovsetvegen, Vatne.
findings.note: ZIv text matches the commercial VR/PC product New Retro Arcade: Neon, not a documented public Norwegian arcade. Cab names are rebranded NRA:N minigames. Treat as non-verified venue; no independent public-arcade confirmation.

findings.name: Pollett Bislett

findings.note: Live venue site pollettbislett.no markets pinball, arkade, and bilbane only. insert-coin.app also lists Arcade 5 / Pinball 14 / racing (Sega Rally 2, Star Wars Racer) with no rhythm titles. Positive non-rhythm floor.

findings.name: Work-Work
findings.evidence_quote: Bar and games venue in Trondheim — shuffleboard, pinball, board games, darts and arcade. Arcade: Retro and modern arcade cabinets side by side.
findings.note: ZIv full cab list (2024-11-16): Stern pinballs, Gauntlet Legends, SFIV AE, Donkey Kong, Galaga, HOTD, Time Crisis 5, Espgaluda, Truxton II. findapinball.com confirms pinball-focused floor. No rhythm/music games on any inventory.

findings.name: StepMania Converted Cabinet
findings.evidence_quote: This is (maybe) the only DDR machine in the south of Peru. is on the third floor of Centro Comercial Imperial Plaza... is an stepmania converted cabinet. it has a lot of songs (all ddr songs until 2014) but it has an ITG theme... S/. 1.00 per 3 songs. Music Game: StepMania Converted Cabinet.
findings.note: Positive historical evidence of a StepMania/ITG-style dance pad cab (not commercial StepManiaX product; mapped to other). Last ZIv update 2018. Imperial Plaza still has a games zone (Nory Play / plaza promo), but no 2023-2026 confirmation this pad still exists. Do not treat as official DDR.
